title: En uundværlig app i min hverdag.
body:
Jeg har snart benyttet mig af denne app i 2 1/2 år, og jeg er simpelthen så glad for den. Jeg begyndte at bruge den så snart jeg fik min ADHD-diagnose, og den hjælper mig virkelig meget med at få styr på min hverdag. Det tog mig lige en lille uges tid med brug før jeg rigtig fangede hvordan alting fungerede. 

Jeg havde brugt den gratisse version indtil fornyeligt, hvor de vælger at belønne mig med et års abonnement til næsten ingen penge, fordi jeg havde været med så længe. Jeg var allerede glad for appen før, nu er jeg endnu mere glad for den. Den betalte version er alle pengene værd, også til fuld pris. 5/5, jeg har smidt alle de andre lignende apps ud! Den her kan det hele. 

Det eneste jeg savner er, at man kan dele sin tidslinje med andre.

title: Nice app, almost perdfect
body: I have autism and ADD and hoped this app could make my every day life easier. But the main problem I have is that I constantly get bombarded with thoughts and ideas I can’t control. This makes it very hard for me to focus and get a task done that is planned. A feature that would help me SO much is the ability to set reminders after a task is begun. Maybe even automatically change focus mode so I get less distracted. There could be a reminder to ask you how you are progressing or if you have even started. I need this to be an option so when I have heard the reminder for a third time, then my brain has easier to focus on the upcoming task because I get multiple reminders. Hope you will consider this to be an update in the future.

title: Best ADHD app - changed my life
body: Definetely best ADHD app. Cheaper than other apps, and it just works. It sends reminders to my Apple Watch which makes me remember things. I love the that I have a general todo where I can save everything I need to remember and can drag and drop it in. I also love that I can see on a timeline what’s next and it became so easy to see what I have done (tada list), what I missed, if I took medicine and as you visually can see how long a task takes you get a feeling for the days tasks. i also found the option to sync with my apple calendar very good. if I could ask for more - the possibility to sync with another person’s structured app to send tasks to others inbox or specific days and the possibility to put things in the inbox that have a deadline

title: Alright, but need more features
body:
The app is okay but there is some stuff that need to get better. 

First of the time setting system is just to tedious, think a fix would be being able to hold down on a task and move it around. You could add on this by enabling a switch that would make you able to move more at a time, say you didn’t start your task at the right time and now you won’t finish it at the right time. Now you have to go in and change every time stamp on your next couple of tasks. Not having this almost makes it easier to just use your notes as a day planer. 

Also think that there should be an option for skipping a task and a way to keep count of the task you’ve done. 

There is also a big lack of icons and the app and widgets are pretty ugly. 

It would be amazing if you guys were able to ad a check list, so let’s say I did 3 sets of an exercise, I would like to have a place to confirm that I did that.

I would really be amazing if these features or some variation of them could be added. I’m currently using one app for the check list and one for the day planer. And I’ve spend like 2 hours on making my tasks for just one day and I ended up having to delete half of my them because I didn’t start at the right time and other stuff came in the way. 

This idea has great potential and your app has in my opinion the most. 

Keep it up know y’all are decent people
Bye
